title: Bolt-circle pipe flange
purpose: Measure a standard mechanical part that combines concentric profiles, an axial bore, and a polar bolt pattern.
complexityRationale: The part requires an annular extrusion, a central through bore, and a six-instance polar through-hole operation.

turns.text: Create a 12 mm thick pipe flange with a 90 mm outer diameter, a 44 mm through bore, and six 8 mm through holes equally spaced on a 70 mm bolt circle.

requirements.description: The final flange envelope is 90 by 90 by 12 mm.
The central bore and all six bolt holes are through features with the requested diameters.

forbiddenOutcomes.reason: Visual resemblance cannot replace through-hole and diameter evidence.

sourceSafety.notes: Generic flange dimensions authored for the public corpus.
